content.text: AutoRecruit — Ideal setup
Five trust contours, cold to hot. iroh + Headscale is the management spine; target egress is always the RU proxy; every required third party is assume-compromised (sees content, never your origin).
Contours (cold -> hot)
OPERATOR (cold):
any device, reaches Hub only via an IP-blind edge (Cloudflare Tunnel). No fixed home IP touches prod. Nice-to-have: FIDO2 hardware key, hardened browser profile.
PROD CORE (warm, pet):

prodbox = matrix-os, Postgres (state, source of truth), Matrix, Hermes x4, workers, Browser Viewer, Hub backend, MLflow, :8317 router. Long-lived, PITR backups, hardened (vault/SGX). Never touches target sites, never rotated.
INFERENCE (elastic):

:8317 is a sensitivity-aware router. Providers: RentGPU (live agentic, ephemeral rented GPU), macbox llama.cpp (eval-gen async via iroh-blobs; optional cheap local inference), cloud LLM (overflow). Route identity-bearing prompts to macbox-local or a secure-cloud GPU; bulk to cheapest.
HANDS (hot, cattle):
fleet of ephemeral browser runtimes, own netns, RU-proxy-only egress, reached only via iroh relay. Burn on leak; never co-located with prod core.
UNTRUSTED 3P (assume compromised):
RU proxy, mail/SMS/CAPTCHA providers, marketplaces. See content (inherent), never your origin (hidden). Per-account, burnable, no reuse.
Hands substrate — recommendation (hybrid)
Buy 1-2 bare-metal boxes (Hetzner/OVH) -> run Proxmox you OWN (no provider sees your VM disk/traffic).
On it: CubeSandbox / Firecracker microVMs for ephemeral Hands (fast spawn, per-account, burn after); full VMs for persistent goldens (VulpineOS / QEMU-Android / Lume) you snapshot.
Keep exe.dev as burst/overflow + fallback while you build the substrate. Do not rip it out day one.
Rotation — your cron idea, calibrated
Hands microVM: rotate per-account / per-session (cattle, cheap). Primary hygiene lever.

Substrate box: blue/green every 6-10 days (randomized) - provision new, join mesh, pass a coherence smoke test, drain, cut over, destroy old. Guards against provider profiling + management-plane IP hygiene. Good idea; automate it.
RentGPU: ephemeral per-workload.
NEVER rotate state-bearing nodes (Postgres, Matrix identities, Hermes personas) - it breaks continuity. Prod core = harden + back up, not rotate.
RentGPU — trust note

The GPU host operator can read VRAM (prompts + weights). Treat as content-exposed: route identity-bearing agentic prompts to macbox-local or a reputable secure-cloud GPU (e.g. RunPod Secure Cloud); send only generic/bulk to cheapest spot GPUs. Disk encryption helps little against a malicious host.
Nice-to-haves
Dedicated tiny coordinator VPS for Headscale control + iroh relay, decoupled from the app core.
Self-host catch-all mail on your domain with a dedicated receiving IP + Nym on the receive path.
iroh-blobs for all dataset/artifact movement (content-addressed, verified, resumable).
Per-account everything (proxy, mailbox, number) - no reuse. Primary anti-correlation lever.
Secrets in a vault; Postgres PITR; coherence smoke-test gate before any new Hands host goes live.
Open
Headscale control home: dedicated coordinator VPS (recommended) vs prodbox.
Which secure-cloud GPU provider for sensitive agentic inference.
AutoRecruit contours — corrected + MUST
Colors encode exposure: green owned, blue policy/projection, turquoise private management, purple external ingress, yellow content-exposed provider, orange semi-trusted Hands, red hostile web.
Concrete capacity
Two small Iroh relay VPS instances in different providers, ASNs, and preferably regions.
Two control servers: authority/state owner and workers/viewer-bridge standby; no split-brain execution authority.
Postgres primary plus a physically separate PITR/immutable backup target.
Two owned Proxmox Hands hosts for N+1 capacity; exe.dev remains burst and fallback.
Headscale coordinator is optional and serves stable owned fleet only; it is not cascaded through Iroh.
Non-negotiable gates
Target navigation starts only after same-browser coherence evidence and signed mutation preflight.
Iroh and Headscale are management paths, never target-site egress.
Account Identity Capsule binds profile, proxy, mailbox, phone, locale, fingerprint seed, and resource lifecycle.
Cloud and rented GPUs are content-exposed; identity-bearing prompts stay local or on explicitly approved secure compute.
